results.name: Engulfing / hammer at a session level
results.rules: A bullish engulfing or hammer candle within 0.25 ATR of VWAP, the developing POC, or an IB extreme leans long; a bearish engulfing or shooting star at the same levels leans short, before 15:00.

results.name: Hoffman inventory retracement bar in an 8/20 EMA trend
results.rules: With EMA8 above EMA20 and the close above EMA20, a bar at least half an ATR tall that undercuts the prior bar's low, closes green, and has a lower wick of 45% or more of its range leans long (mirror for shorts in a downtrend), between 10:00 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Inside bar / NR4 at a session level
results.rules: An inside bar or an NR4 bar (narrowest of itself and the prior 3) within 0.25 ATR of VWAP or yesterday's high/low marks compression at a level. The first of the next 3 bars whose close breaks that bar's own high/low leans with the breakout, before 15:00.

results.name: Pin bar rejection at yesterday's high/low
results.rules: A 5-minute bar (9:45-14:30, range at least 1 ATR) that wicks through yesterday's low and closes back above it, with the lower wick at least 60% of the range and twice the body, leans long; the mirror at yesterday's high leans short. One per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Yesterday's wick zone: body-edge rejection
results.rules: On a day that opens inside yesterday's range, the first time price rises into yesterday's upper wick (reaches the top of yesterday's candle body without trading at yesterday's high) and closes back under that body edge it leans short; the mirror at the bottom of the body leans long. Wick zones under 0.5 ATR are skipped; 09:45-14:00 ET; one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Morning / evening star at the VWAP 1-sigma band
results.rules: A big candle (0.8 ATR body), a small-bodied candle (under 30% of it) that reaches the VWAP +/- 1 sigma band on the stretched side, then a candle closing back past the first candle's midpoint is a three-candle star reversal. 10:00 to 15:00 ET, first one a session.

results.name: Three white soldiers / three black crows (5-min)
results.rules: Three consecutive 5-minute candles of the same colour, each with a body of at least 60% of its range, each closing in the outer 25% of its range and beyond the previous close, and each opening inside the previous body. Signals in the pattern's direction at the third close, 10:00-15:00 ET. One per session.

results.name: Tweezer bottom/top at the session extreme
results.rules: Two consecutive 5-minute candles of opposite color whose lows (tweezer bottom: first down, second up) or highs (tweezer top: first up, second down) match within 0.05 ATR, with that price being the session's lowest low (highest high) so far. The bottom leans long and the top leans short at the second candle's close. 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: IB + initial-volume breakout outside value
results.rules: IB breakout in the same direction as an earlier initial-volume breakout, with price already outside yesterday's value area.

results.name: POC migration by 11:30
results.rules: At 11:30 the developing POC sits outside yesterday's value area; lean the way value moved.

results.name: Protected level at VWAP holds
results.rules: Pullback to a protected level within 0.25 ATR of VWAP that closes back on the trend side of both.

results.name: Sweep, then VWAP cross
results.rules: Sweep of yesterday's high/low or the IB extreme, then within 30 minutes a close back across VWAP.

results.name: 20-day breakout
results.rules: Daily close above the prior 20-day high (below the 20-day low).

results.name: RSI(2) pullback in trend
results.rules: Above the 200-day average with RSI(2) under 10 (or below it with RSI(2) over 90).

results.name: NR7 breakout
results.rules: Day after the narrowest range of the last 7 days closes beyond that day's range.

results.name: Inside-day breakout
results.rules: Close beyond the mother bar's range the day after an inside day.

results.name: ABC pullback after an impulse leg
results.rules: A swing-to-swing impulse leg of at least 1.5 ATR is followed by a three-swing ABC correction (A against the impulse, B a bounce staying inside the impulse extreme, C retracing 38.2%-78.6% of the impulse and holding beyond the impulse's start). The first close back beyond B in the impulse's direction leans with the impulse resuming, before 15:00.

results.name: AB=CD harmonic completion
results.rules: After a swing leg AB of at least 1 ATR and a 38.2-78.6% retracement BC, price travelling an equal leg CD to point D completes the AB=CD pattern: leans against the CD leg (long at a completed down CD, short at a completed up CD), at the close of the bar that first reaches D, before 15:00.

results.name: 61.8% retracement of the opening drive holds
results.rules: The first 30 minutes' directional push (open to its own extreme) defines the opening drive. The first bar that trades to the 61.8% retracement of that drive (measured back from the extreme toward the open) and closes back in the drive's direction confirms the level held, before 15:00.

results.name: Gartley 222 completion at 0.786 of XA
results.rules: Four alternating swing pivots X, A, B, C with XA at least 1.5 ATR, B retracing 0.618 of XA (within 0.05) and C retracing 38.2-88.6% of AB. Point D is the 0.786 retracement of XA. At the close of the first bar to reach D without trading beyond X, lean against the CD leg (long at a bullish D, short at a bearish D), before 15:00. One per side per session.

results.name: 15-minute opening range breakout
results.rules: First 5-minute close beyond the 9:30-9:45 range, before 10:30.

results.name: Initial balance breakout
results.rules: First 5-minute close beyond the first-hour (9:30-10:30) high or low, before 14:00.

results.name: Failed IB breakout (fade)
results.rules: IB breaks, then closes back inside within 30 minutes; lean the other way.

results.name: Initial volume breakout
results.rules: Close beyond the high/low of the heaviest-volume bar of the first 30 minutes, on 1.5x normal volume for the time of day, before 12:00.

results.name: Value-area re-entry (80% rule)
results.rules: Open outside yesterday's value area, then 30 minutes of closes back inside; lean toward the far edge.

results.name: Pull to yesterday's POC
results.rules: Open inside yesterday's value area at least 1 ATR from its POC and drifting toward it after 30 minutes.

results.name: Value-area edge rejection
results.rules: Probe of yesterday's VAH/VAL from inside that closes back inside on a rejection bar.

results.name: Acceptance outside value
results.rules: Six straight closes above yesterday's VAH (or below VAL) after 10:00; lean with it.

results.name: VWAP reclaim / loss
results.rules: 30+ minutes on one side of VWAP, then a close through it on 1.2x normal volume.

results.name: VWAP 2-sigma snap-back
results.rules: Close outside the 2-sigma VWAP band, next close back inside; lean toward VWAP.

results.name: Sweep of yesterday's high/low
results.rules: Wick through yesterday's high (low) and close back below (above) it.

results.name: Sweep of the IB extreme
results.rules: After 10:30, wick beyond the IB high (low) and close back inside.

results.name: Change of character (protected level breaks)
results.rules: The protected swing that held the trend is closed through.

results.name: Break of structure (continuation)
results.rules: Close beyond the last swing in the trend's direction.

results.name: Protected level holds
results.rules: Pullback to within 0.25 ATR of the protected level, closes back on the trend side with a rejection bar.

results.name: Gap fill attempt
results.rules: Gap of 0.25%+ and the first 30 minutes already moving back toward yesterday's close.

results.name: Power-hour trend
results.rules: At 15:00, price above VWAP and above the IB high (or below both); lean with it into the close.

results.name: MACD histogram flip with VWAP agreement
results.rules: MACD(12,26,9) histogram flips from negative to positive with price closing above VWAP leans long; the mirror flip to negative with price below VWAP leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00, after a 35-bar warmup.

results.name: RSI(14) divergence at the day's high/low
results.rules: A new session high with RSI(14) lower than at the prior session-high bar (bearish divergence) leans short; a new session low with RSI higher than at the prior session-low bar (bullish divergence) leans long. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Wilder RSI(14) failure swing
results.rules: RSI(14) drops under 30, rebounds above 30 to a peak, pulls back without a new low or a re-entry under 30, then closes above that peak (mirror: over 70, trough, higher high not made, breaks the trough). RSI is restarted each session; signals 10:45 to 14:30; one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Volume-weighted MACD signal-line cross
results.rules: The volume-weighted MACD is the 12-bar volume-weighted average price minus the 26-bar one, on 5-minute closes, with a 9-bar signal line. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross of the signal line upward leans long and the first cross downward leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Zero-Lag MACD (12/26/9) signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: MACD built from zero-lag EMAs (12 and 26, each fed 2*close minus the close half a period ago), restarted each session: the MACD line crossing above its 9-bar signal line with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Awesome Oscillator saucer
results.rules: Awesome Oscillator (5 minus 34 bar average of bar midpoints, five-minute bars, built inside the session so it starts about 12:20 ET): above zero on three bars with the first two falling and the third rising leans long; the mirror below zero leans short. Until 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session.

results.name: Balance of Power zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Balance of Power scores each 5-minute bar by how far it closed from its open as a share of its range (+1 all buyers, -1 all sellers), averaged over 14 bars. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross of that average up through zero while price is above VWAP leans long, the first cross down through zero while price is below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: CCI(20) extreme re-entry
results.rules: Commodity Channel Index (20 five-minute bars, typical price): after CCI dips below -200 within the last three bars and a bar closes back above -100, it leans long; the mirror (above +200, then back under +100) leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session.

results.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator re-entry from +/-50
results.rules: The Chande Momentum Oscillator compares the sum of up closes with the sum of down closes over 14 5-minute bars, from -100 to +100. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross back up through -50 leans long and the first cross back down through +50 leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Connors Double 7 (7-day closing low in an uptrend)
results.rules: Close above the 200-day average and at or below the lowest close of the last 7 days leans long at the next open (mirrored below the 200-day average at a 7-day closing high). Tested with and against, with the lab's standard exits rather than the published highest-close exit.

results.name: ConnorsRSI re-entry from 10/90
results.rules: ConnorsRSI averages a 3-bar RSI of price, a 2-bar RSI of the up/down streak length and the percent rank of the latest bar's return among earlier returns that session. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross back up through 10 leans long and the first cross back down through 90 leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Coppock curve turn against zero
results.rules: Coppock is a weighted average of two rates of change (14 and 11 bars). Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it is below zero and turns up it leans long; when above zero and it turns down it leans short. Needs about two hours of session history. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: DeMark Range Expansion Index re-entry from +/-45
results.rules: Tom DeMark's 5-bar Range Expansion Index (high and low moves two bars apart, zeroed when the bar gaps away from the range of 5-8 bars ago). When it climbs back above -45 from oversold the setup leans long; when it drops back below +45 from overbought it leans short. 10:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: DeMarker re-entry from 0.30 / 0.70
results.rules: The DeMarker oscillator compares how much each 5-minute bar's high exceeds the previous high with how much its low undercuts the previous low, over 14 bars (0 to 1). Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross back up through 0.30 leans long and the first cross back down through 0.70 leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Detrended Price Oscillator (10) trough/peak turn
results.rules: DPO(10) (close minus the 10-bar average shifted back 6 bars) is below zero, bottoms and ticks up on a bar that closes above its open (mirror: above zero, peaks, ticks down on a down bar), between 10:30 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Fisher Transform extreme crossover
results.rules: Ehlers Fisher Transform (9 five-minute bars): when the Fisher line turns up through its one-bar-lagged trigger while below -1.5, it leans long; turning down through the trigger while above +1.5, it leans short. From 10:15 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session.

results.name: Daily IBS extreme
results.rules: A daily close in the bottom 20% of its own high-low range (IBS < 0.2) leans long into the next session; a close in the top 20% (IBS > 0.8) leans short.

results.name: Intraday Momentum Index (14) re-entry from 30/70
results.rules: Chande's Intraday Momentum Index over 14 five-minute bars (sum of up-bar bodies over up plus down bodies). IMI crossing back above 30 leans long; crossing back below 70 leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Inverse Fisher RSI(5) crossing back through -0.5 / +0.5
results.rules: Ehlers' inverse Fisher transform of a smoothed 5-bar RSI (RSI-50, x0.1, 9-bar weighted average). Long when it crosses up through -0.5, short when it crosses down through +0.5, 10:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two a session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Know Sure Thing signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: The Know Sure Thing adds up four smoothed rates of change (5, 8, 10 and 15 bars, longer ones weighted more) into one momentum line and compares it with its own 5-bar average. Between 11:30 and 14:30, the first time the line crosses above its average while price is above VWAP leans long; the first cross below while price is below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Laguerre RSI re-entry from 0.15 / 0.85
results.rules: Ehlers' Laguerre RSI is a heavily smoothed RSI that runs 0 to 1. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross back up through 0.15 leans long and the first cross back down through 0.85 leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Momentum Pinball: first-hour break after a stretched prior day
results.rules: If yesterday's 3-period RSI of the daily change in close (Raschke's Pinball) closed under 30, look only for longs; over 70, only shorts. After the first hour, lean with the first close beyond that hour's high (long) or low (short), before 14:00. One per day.

results.name: Polarized Fractal Efficiency zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: PFE (10 bars, 5-bar smoothing) measures how straight the last ten bars' path was, signed by direction. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it turns from negative to positive and price closes above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Price Momentum Oscillator (35/20/10) signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: Swenlin's Price Momentum Oscillator is a rate of change smoothed twice. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it crosses above its 10-bar signal line while still below zero and price closes above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror (cross down while above zero, price under VWAP) leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Pretty Good Oscillator +/-3 breakout
results.rules: PGO is how far the close sits from its 14-bar average, measured in average true ranges. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross above +3 leans long and the first cross below -3 leans short (Mark Johnson's breakout rule). One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Price Zone Oscillator re-entry from +/-40
results.rules: PZO is the 14-bar EMA of the close signed by the direction of each bar's change, divided by the 14-bar EMA of the close. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it climbs back above -40 it leans long; when it falls back below +40 it leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Qstick zero-line cross with VWAP
results.rules: Qstick is the 8-bar average of candle bodies (close minus open). Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it turns from negative to positive and price closes above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror (positive to negative, price under VWAP) leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Raschke 3-10 oscillator signal-line cross with the zero line
results.rules: Oscillator = 3-bar average minus 10-bar average of the 5-minute median price; signal line = its 16-bar average. Osc crossing above the signal line while above zero leans long; crossing below while under zero leans short. One signal per side per session, 10:30 to 14:30.

results.name: Relative strength vs SPY continuation
results.rules: Between 10:00 and 13:00, a stock that has outrun SPY since the open by at least four of its own 5-minute ATRs (in percent), trading on the same side of its VWAP, leans with the leader on an up bar (long) or the laggard on a down bar (short). One signal per side per session; SPY itself is skipped.

results.name: RSI(14) of VWAP re-entry from 30/70
results.rules: Wilder RSI(14) computed on the running session VWAP (not price). When it crosses back up through 30 the setup leans long; when it crosses back down through 70 it leans short, between 10:15 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Intraday RSI(2) extreme
results.rules: On 5-minute bars, a close with RSI(2) below 5 leans long (oversold snap-back) and above 95 leans short, between 10:00 and 14:30, at most once per side per session.

results.name: Relative Vigor Index signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: The Relative Vigor Index measures whether bars tend to close near their highs (vigor up) or lows. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it crosses above its signal line while still below zero (a turn up from weakness) and price closes above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror (cross down while above zero, price under VWAP) leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Schaff Trend Cycle leaving its trigger zones
results.rules: The Schaff Trend Cycle (MACD 12/26 run through two 10-bar stochastic passes, smoothed 0.5) closes back up through 25 (leans long) or back down through 75 (leans short). Only after 30 bars of the session, 10:00-14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Stochastic Momentum Index cross out of +/-40
results.rules: Blau's Stochastic Momentum Index (10,3,3) measures where price closes relative to the middle of its recent 10-bar range. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it crosses above its 3-bar signal line while still below -40 (oversold) it leans long; crossing below the signal while above +40 (overbought) leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Stochastic(14,3,3) crossover from overbought/oversold
results.rules: Slow Stochastic(14,3,3) on 5-minute bars. %K crossing above %D while both are below 20 (oversold) leans long; %K crossing below %D while both are above 80 (overbought) leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Stochastic Pop (14,3,3) through 80 / 20 with VWAP side
results.rules: Slow stochastic (14,3,3) %D line crosses up through 80 while the bar closes above VWAP (mirror: crosses down through 20 below VWAP) between 10:00 and 14:30. Read as momentum continuation, not overbought. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.

results.name: Stochastic(10) pullback cross on the VWAP side
results.rules: Raw 10-bar stochastic %K crosses its 3-bar average %D upward after both sat below 30, while the bar closes above VWAP (mirror: crosses down from above 70 below VWAP), between 10:00 and 14:30. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.

results.name: Stochastic RSI cross in the extreme zone, with VWAP side
results.rules: Stochastic RSI (RSI 14, Stochastic 14, %K 3, %D 3) on 5-minute bars, restarted each session. Between 10:15 and 14:30 ET, %K crossing up through %D while %K is still below 20 and the bar closes above session VWAP: long. %K crossing down through %D above 80 with the close below VWAP: short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Six-close streak exhaustion
results.rules: Six 5-minute closes in a row in one direction covering at least 2.5 ATR, then a bar that closes against the run with a real body (30%+ of its range): leans against the run (fade) or with it, both tested. One signal per session, 10:00 to 14:30.

results.name: True Strength Index signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: The True Strength Index is a double-smoothed measure of price momentum. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when it crosses above its 9-bar signal line while still below zero (a turn up from weakness) and price closes above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror (cross down while above zero, price under VWAP) leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Ultimate Oscillator divergence breakout
results.rules: Larry Williams' Ultimate Oscillator blends 7, 14 and 28-bar buying pressure. A bullish signal needs price to make a lower low while the oscillator makes a higher low, the first low having been below 30; it triggers when the oscillator rises back above its highest reading between the two lows (mirror above 70 for bearish). Signals between 10:30 and 14:30, within 8 bars of the second swing, one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: WaveTrend cross out of the +/-53 zone
results.rules: WaveTrend (LazyBear) smooths a CCI-style reading of the typical price. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when the fast line crosses up through its 4-bar signal line while still at or below -53 (stretched down), it leans long; the mirror cross down from +53 or higher leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Williams Accumulation/Distribution divergence at a new session extreme
results.rules: Williams Accumulation/Distribution (a price-only running sum: up bars add the close minus the true low, down bars subtract the true high minus the close) fails to confirm a new session closing high (it sits below its value at the previous high, at least 6 bars earlier) leans short; a new closing low on a line above its value at the previous low leans long. After 18 bars, before 14:30 ET, one signal a session; tested with and against.

results.name: Williams %R recovering through its midline, with VWAP
results.rules: The 10-bar Williams %R was at or below -80 within the last 12 bars and now closes back up through -50 with price above session VWAP (leans long); mirror: it was at or above -20 and closes down through -50 with price below VWAP (leans short). 10:00-14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Woodies CCI zero-line reject with VWAP
results.rules: CCI(14) on typical price has been above zero on at least 5 of the 6 bars before the last two (an established uptrend), the prior bar pulled back to within 50 of the zero line, and now CCI turns up back above zero with price closing above VWAP: leans long (mirror for short). Between 10:30 and 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Andrews pitchfork median-line pullback
results.rules: From the last three alternating swing points (3 bars each side, 4+ bars apart; low-high-low with a higher second low, or high-low-high with a lower second high) draw the median line from the first point through the midpoint of the other two. A bar that dips to within 0.15 ATR of it and closes back above it as an up bar (mirror for a down fork) is the signal. 10:00-15:00, one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Bull/bear flag after a 2-ATR impulse
results.rules: A net move over the last 4 bars of at least 2x that bar's ATR marks an impulse. The following bars form a flag as long as each one's own range stays within 60% of the impulse bars' average range and the pullback never exceeds 50% of the impulse, for up to 8 bars. The first close beyond the flag's own high (low) confirms the breakout in the impulse's direction.

results.name: Darvas box breakout with VWAP
results.rules: A box forms when a 5-minute high (the highest of the previous 6 bars) is not exceeded for the next 3 bars; the box floor is the lowest low from that high through those 3 bars, and the box must be at least 0.75 ATR tall. A close above the box top within 12 bars of confirmation, on the VWAP side, leans long; the mirror box (a low held for 3 bars) closing below its floor under VWAP leans short. 10:00 to 15:00 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Double top / bottom at a prior-day level
results.rules: Two confirmed swing highs (lows) both within 0.3 ATR of yesterday's high (low), the second no more than 0.1 ATR above (below) the first, mark a double top (bottom) at that level. The first close back through the low (high) between the two peaks (troughs) confirms it and leans against the level, before 15:00.

results.name: Head and shoulders neckline break (and inverse)
results.rules: Three 5-minute pivots with the middle one beyond both shoulders by 0.5 ATR, shoulders within 1 ATR, neckline (lower of the two pivots between them) at least 1 ATR from the head; the first close through the neckline within 12 bars of the right shoulder, before the head is retaken, is the signal; the inverse pattern mirrors it. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, one per side per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Hikkake: inside-bar false breakout
results.rules: Between 10:00 and 14:30, a 5-minute inside bar. If price breaks below its low and, within 3 bars, a bar closes back above its high, the trap leans long (mirror for a false break up). One per day.

results.name: Hourly inside-bar breakout
results.rules: When one hour's high and low both sit inside the prior hour's range, the first 5-minute close above that inside hour's high leans long and the first close below its low leans short, before 15:00.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Inside day, then opening gap out of its range
results.rules: Yesterday's whole range sat inside the day before's range. Today opens above yesterday's high (or below its low) and the 10:00 close is still beyond it: lean with the break at the 10:00 close, once per session.

results.name: Island reversal (daily)
results.rules: Price gaps up (the day's low is above the prior day's high), trades in a cluster of 1 to 5 sessions that never fills that gap, then gaps back down (the day's high is below the prior day's low): an island top, leaning short on that close. The mirror image after a gap down is an island bottom, leaning long.

results.name: Jensen 123 reversal with 9-bar stochastic filter
results.rules: Two consecutive lower closes then a bar that closes above the previous close, with the 9-bar stochastic (3-bar average, session bars) below 30 one bar earlier and rising: long. Mirror: two higher closes, then a lower close, stochastic above 70 and falling: short. 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Key reversal bar at the session extreme
results.rules: After the first hour, a bar that makes a new session low and closes above the previous bar's high leans long; a bar that makes a new session high and closes below the previous bar's low leans short. Before 15:00, at most two per session.

results.name: Morning high/low retest that fails
results.rules: The day's high (or low) is set before 11:00 and price moves at least 1.5 ATR away. Between 12:00 and 15:00 a bar comes within 0.15 ATR of that extreme without breaking it and closes at least 0.3 ATR back from it. Tested with and against the rejection; one signal per side per session.

results.name: Ross Hook after a 1-2-3 breakout
results.rules: After a close beyond the last swing high (or low) that breaks the market structure, the first 5-minute bar within the next six that fails to make a new high (or low) beyond the bar before it is the hook, and price leans with the breakout. Between 10:00 and 15:00, one per session.

results.name: Williams smash-bar reversal (5-minute)
results.rules: A 5-minute bar of at least 1 ATR closes below the previous bar's low and below the close one hour earlier (a smash). If within three bars a bar closes back above the smash bar's high, that close leans long; mirror for a smash up. 10:30-15:00, one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Strat 2-1-2 reversal (15-minute)
results.rules: On 15-minute candles, a candle that takes out only the prior high (2U) or only the prior low (2D), then an inside candle: the first 5-minute close below the inside candle's low after a 2U leans short, and above its high after a 2D leans long, before 15:00.

results.name: Strat 3-1-2 break (30-minute)
results.rules: On 30-minute candles, an outside candle (3) followed by an inside candle (1): the first 5-minute close above the inside candle's high leans long, below its low leans short (2), before 15:00. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Symmetrical triangle breakout on volume
results.rules: Two lower swing highs and two higher swing lows (converging lines, at least 0.5 ATR wide at the first swing, within the last 36 bars) form a symmetrical triangle. The first close beyond the projected line by 0.1 ATR on a bar with at least 1.5x the previous 10 bars' average volume leans with the break, once per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Three drives to a high / low
results.rules: Three consecutive swing highs, each at least 0.2 ATR above the last and 3+ bars apart (or three swing lows, each lower), mark three pushes into exhaustion. The bar that confirms the third swing leans against the push, before 15:00, once per side per session.

results.name: Three lower hourly highs and lows in a row, read at 10:30
results.rules: Hourly bars (12 five-minute bars from 9:30). Look at the prior session's last three hourly bars and today's first one (9:30-10:30). If each of the three steps made a lower high and a lower low, signal at the 10:30 close (the published version buys it; the mirror with higher highs and higher lows is the short side). Tested with and against, one signal per session.

results.name: Tight pause at the day extreme after a thrust: break
results.rules: A 6-bar thrust of 2+ ATR into a session high (low), then 4 small bars (range 1.5 ATR or less) hugging that extreme; the first close beyond the pause within 6 bars is the signal, 10:30 to 14:30. Tested with and against; one per side per session.

results.name: Swing trendline break and first retest
results.rules: Draw a line through the last two swing highs (3 bars each side, at least 6 bars apart, the later one lower). When a bar closes more than a quarter ATR above it, wait up to 8 bars for a bar that dips back to within half an ATR of the line and closes back above it; that close is the signal (mirror for a rising line under swing lows). 10:00-15:00, one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Wolfe wave: point 5 through the 1-3 line, close back inside
results.rules: Five alternating 5-minute pivots; for a bullish wave: 1 low, 2 high, 3 low at least 0.3 ATR below 1, 4 high between 1 and 2, wave height 2 to 3 at least 1 ATR, point 5 low at least 0.1 ATR under the 1-3 line projected to its bar. The first close back above that line within 6 bars of point 5's confirmation is the signal; the bearish wave mirrors it. 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one per side per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Three strong closes into a new session extreme
results.rules: Between 10:00 and 14:00, three consecutive 5-minute bars each closing in the top 30% of their range with rising closes, the third printing a new session high, leans long; the mirror leans short. One per side per session; tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Failed high/low-of-day break on dying volume
results.rules: Between 09:50 and 12:50, a bar that pokes through the running session high (set at least 6 bars earlier) by no more than 0.5 ATR on below-average volume, then closes back under it with the 9 EMA below the 20 EMA, leans short; the mirror at the session low leans long. One signal per side per session.

results.name: First pullback to the 9/20 EMA after the opening drive
results.rules: By 10:00 a 5-minute bar closes at a new session high (low) with the 9 EMA above (below) the 20 EMA. The first bar before 10:45 that dips to the 9 EMA without touching the 20 EMA and closes back beyond the 9 EMA is the first pullback; lean with the drive. A close through the 20 EMA cancels it.

results.name: Second-entry pullback (H2 / L2)
results.rules: In an uptrend above a rising VWAP, after a new session high, wait for a pullback of 0.5-2.5 ATR that never closes under VWAP. The second bar that pokes above the prior bar's high (after a lower-high bar) and closes up is the H2 and leans long; the mirror below VWAP is the L2 and leans short, before 15:00.

results.name: VWAP-held higher lows / lower highs break
results.rules: Two successive swing lows (5-bar pivots) form, the second higher than the first and both above VWAP, the later one between 10:00 and 13:30 ET; the first close above the highest high since the first pivot, before 14:30, leans long (mirror for lower highs below VWAP). One signal per session, in the direction of the break; tested with and against.

results.name: Late-day close at the day extreme
results.rules: At the first 5-minute close at or after 14:00 ET, if the day's range is at least 8 ATR and the close sits in the top 10% of the range and above VWAP, lean long (bottom 10% and below VWAP, lean short). One signal a day. Tested with and against the signal.

results.name: Break of structure (continuation), before 11:00 only
results.rules: Same event as bos (close beyond the last swing in the trend's direction) but only counted when the break closes before 11:00 ET, instead of the usual 10:00-15:00 window.

results.name: Change of character, before 11:00 only
results.rules: Same event as choch (the protected swing that held the trend is closed through) but only counted when it closes before 11:00 ET, instead of the usual 10:00-15:00 window.

results.name: ACD A-up / A-down break
results.rules: Opening range is the first 30 minutes. A is 10% of yesterday's high-low range. The first 5-minute close above the opening-range high plus A (below the low minus A) between 10:00 and 14:30 leans with the break. One signal per session.

results.name: Crabel opening-range stretch breakout
results.rules: Stretch = average over the last 10 sessions of the smaller of (open minus low) and (high minus open). A 5-minute close above the open plus the stretch, or below the open minus it, between 9:45 and 11:00 leans with the break. One signal per session.

results.name: Flip back through the day's open after a committed first hour
results.rules: When yesterday closed up (down) and the first hour ends at least 0.75 ATR above (below) today's open without a 5-minute close through it, the first close between 10:35 and 14:30 that is 0.25 ATR through the open leans the opposite way (short after an up first hour, long after a down one). One signal per session.

results.name: Dual Thrust breakout
results.rules: Range = the larger of (highest high - lowest close) and (highest close - lowest low) over the last 4 sessions. Buy line = today's open + 0.5 x Range, sell line = open - 0.5 x Range. The first 5-minute close beyond a line between 09:45 and 14:30 leans that way, once per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Yesterday's failed IB auction: next-day reaction
results.rules: If yesterday broke its initial balance, closed back inside it within 30 minutes and finished the day inside it, the failed side is treated as unfinished business and today's first read at 10:00 ET leans the other way (short after a failed upside break, long after a failed downside break), when today opens inside yesterday's range. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: First half-hour leads the last half-hour
results.rules: If the return from yesterday's close to today's 10:00 close is positive, lean long into the last half-hour (entry 15:30, flat at the close); if negative, lean short.

results.name: Gap capitulation: first-30-minute midpoint reclaimed
results.rules: When the open gaps at least 0.8 ATR from yesterday's close, take the range of the first six 5-minute bars (09:30-09:55). Between 10:00 and 12:00, if price has not made a new extreme past that range in the gap's direction and a bar closes back through the range midpoint against the gap, it leans toward filling the gap (gap down: long). One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Gap with first-bar failure
results.rules: The day opens at least 0.25% away from yesterday's close. If it gapped up and a 5-minute bar closes below the first bar's low (gapped down: closes above its high) between 09:40 and 11:00, the gap is failing and the move leans against it, once per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Opening gap pulls back to its halfway level and holds
results.rules: When the open is at least 0.25% away from yesterday's close and the gap is still unfilled, the first bar after 9:45 (until 14:30) that trades down to (after a gap up) or up to (after a gap down) the halfway level of the gap but closes back on the gap's side of it leans with the gap. One signal per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Heavy-volume gap, quiet first pullback to VWAP holds
results.rules: Open gaps at least 0.5% from yesterday's close on heavy opening volume (first six bars average relative volume 1.5 or more). The first bar from 9:55 that dips to VWAP on volume below the opening bars' average and closes back on the gap's side leans with the gap; if a close ever lands on the wrong side of VWAP first, no signal. Before 14:00, once per session.

results.name: Gap-and-go on heavy early volume
results.rules: A gap of 0.25%+ from yesterday's close with the first 15 minutes averaging 1.3x normal volume for those slots leans WITH the gap direction, fired at 9:45.

results.name: Gap fade on light early volume
results.rules: A gap of 0.25%+ from yesterday's close with the first 15 minutes averaging under 1x normal volume for those slots (no conviction) leans AGAINST the gap direction, fired at 9:45.

results.name: Gap accepted: held its side of VWAP 10:00-10:30
results.rules: Open gaps at least 0.3% from yesterday's close and every 5-minute close from 10:00 to 10:30 stays on the gap's side of VWAP: lean with the gap at the 10:30 close, once per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Initial balance broken on both sides (neutral-day flip)
results.rules: After 10:30, a 5-minute close beyond one end of the 9:30-10:30 initial balance is the first break. If a later bar within two hours closes beyond the opposite end, the first break failed and the day is a neutral day; the signal is the direction of that second break. Tested with it and against it (fade). One per session, before 14:30.

results.name: Initial balance closes at its extreme
results.rules: If the first hour (9:30-10:30) closes in the top 20% of its own range lean long; in the bottom 20% lean short. Signal at the 10:30 close, one per session.

results.name: IB 1x extension exhaustion
results.rules: Once price has travelled a full initial-balance range beyond the IB high (low) and a 5-minute bar closes back under (over) that 1x line, lean back toward the IB. After the first hour, before 15:00, one per side per session.

results.name: Initial balance breakout retest
results.rules: A 5-minute close beyond the 9:30-10:30 initial balance (before 14:00) marks the break. The first bar within the next hour that trades back to the broken edge and closes outside it again confirms the retest; lean with the break. A close back inside the balance cancels it.

results.name: Lunch-hour range breakout
results.rules: Mark the high and low of 11:30-12:30 ET. If that range is at most half the 9:30-11:30 range (a real contraction), the first 5-minute close beyond it before 14:30 leans with the break.

results.name: Afternoon break of an undisturbed morning range
results.rules: If price closes inside the 09:30-11:00 range for the whole stretch to 13:30, then the first close between 13:30 and 14:30 ET beyond the morning high (above VWAP) leans long, or beyond the morning low (below VWAP) leans short.

results.name: Narrow initial balance breakout
results.rules: When the first-hour (9:30-10:30) range is under half of yesterday's high-low range, the first 5-minute close beyond the first-hour high or low, before 14:00, leans with the break. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Compressed 15-minute opening range breakout
results.rules: When the 9:30-9:45 range is no taller than 2.0 of the session's 5-minute ATR, the first 5-minute close beyond it before 11:00 leans with the break. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Noise Area breakout (14-day average move bands around the open)
results.rules: Build bands around the open from the average move at this time of day over the last 14 sessions (upper from the higher of open and yesterday's close, lower from the lower). At a half-hour mark from 10:00 to 15:30, the first close outside a band leans with the break. One per day.

results.name: NR7 day then first-candle opening-range breakout (Crabel)
results.rules: Yesterday's range was the narrowest of the last 7 sessions. If today's first 5-minute candle closes up, the first 5-minute close above its high before 11:00 ET leans long; if it closes down, the first close below its low leans short. One trade per session.

results.name: Oops gap reversal (Larry Williams)
results.rules: Today opens below yesterday's low after a down day (or above yesterday's high after an up day). The first 5-minute close back inside yesterday's range, before 11:30 ET, leans back toward yesterday's range: long after a down gap, short after an up gap.

results.name: Open type: open-drive
results.rules: The session never moves more than 0.15 ATR against its own eventual direction through the initial balance (60 minutes) and closes the IB at least 0.75 ATR from the open: a one-way drive from the bell. Leans with the drive.

results.name: Open type: open-test-drive
results.rules: The first 15 minutes test at least 0.35 ATR opposite the eventual direction, then the IB closes at least 0.35 ATR beyond the open the other way: a fast-failing test followed by a drive. Leans with the drive.

results.name: Open type: open-rejection-reverse
results.rules: Anywhere in the initial balance price tests at least 0.35 ATR one way, then the IB closes at least 0.15 ATR the other way: a slower, less clean rejection than open-test-drive. Leans with the reversal.

results.name: Oversized opening bar reversed through its midpoint
results.rules: The first 5-minute bar has a range of at least 2 ATR and closes in the outer 30% of its range in its own direction. The first later bar before 10:15 that closes beyond that bar's midpoint the other way is the signal, against the opening bar's direction. One per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Opening range edge rejection
results.rules: Until 11:30, while price has not closed outside the 9:30-9:45 range (range at least 1 ATR wide), a 5-minute bar that wicks to within 0.1 ATR of the range low and closes in its top third leans long; one that wicks to the range high and closes in its bottom third leans short. One trade per session.

results.name: OR30 measured-move extension exhausted, fade
results.rules: Take the first 30 minutes' high and low. After 10:00 and before 13:00, a 5-minute bar that trades one full opening-range height beyond the range edge but closes back inside that projection leans the other way (the measured move was reached and rejected). The range must be at least 1.5 ATR tall. One signal per side per session.

results.name: Opening 5-minute bar breakout
results.rules: The first 5-minute bar of the session (09:30-09:35) sets the range. The first later bar that closes above its high leans long, or below its low leans short, before 10:30; one signal per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.

results.name: Opening 5-minute break near VWAP
results.rules: The first 5-minute bar (09:30-09:35) sets the range. The first later bar before 10:30 that closes beyond it leans that way only if it closes on the same side of the session VWAP and within 1 ATR of it; a break that starts stretched from VWAP is skipped, and so is the rest of the session. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Opening range failed breakout
results.rules: A 5-minute close beyond the 9:30-9:45 range before 10:30 marks the break. If a close back inside the range follows within the next 4 bars, the failed break leans the other way (short after a failed break up, long after a failed break down). One trade per session.

results.name: Opening-range break clearing prior-day high/low
results.rules: The first close beyond the 15-minute opening range before 11:00 that is also above yesterday's high (long) or below yesterday's low (short), with price on the same side of session VWAP; one signal per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.

results.name: Opening range breakout retest
results.rules: A 5-minute close beyond the 9:30-9:45 range before 10:30 marks the break. The first bar within the next hour that trades back to the broken edge and closes outside it again confirms the retest; lean with the breakout. A close back inside the range cancels it.

results.name: 15-min opening range break, two closes and a strong body
results.rules: The high and low of 09:30-09:45 set the range. Two consecutive 5-minute closes beyond the same side, the second with a body of at least 60% of its range in the break direction, before 11:00: lean that way at the second close, once per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.

results.name: Opening range break with VWAP and RSI agreement
results.rules: From 10:15 to 11:30, a 5-minute close above the 9:30-9:45 range high, above session VWAP, with RSI(9) of the session's closes at 60 or more leans long; a close below the range low and VWAP with RSI(9) at 40 or less leans short. One trade per session.

results.name: 30-minute opening range break (range >= 0.2%)
results.rules: After the first 30 minutes (9:30-10:00), the first 5-minute close beyond that range before 11:30 leans with the break, only when the 30-minute range is at least 0.2% of the open. One per day.

results.name: 5-minute opening range break on a volume spike
results.rules: Wait for the first bar after 9:35 (before 9:55) that closes beyond the 9:30-9:35 high or low. If that bar's volume is at least 1.5x the usual for its time slot, lean with the breakout; otherwise skip the day.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Outside day closing on its extreme, then IB break with it
results.rules: Yesterday's range engulfed the day before's and it closed in the top (bottom) quarter of its range. The first 5-minute close from 10:30 to 12:55 beyond today's initial balance high (low) in that direction is the signal; one per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Open outside prior range, re-entry
results.rules: When the session opens above yesterday's high or below yesterday's low, the first 5-minute close back inside yesterday's range (before 11:30) leans back toward the range: short after an open above, long after an open below. One signal per session.

results.name: Yesterday's close near its extreme, first hour agrees
results.rules: When yesterday closed in the top (bottom) fifth of its high-low range and, at the 10:30 close, price is above (below) both yesterday's close and VWAP, lean with that direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Open outside yesterday's last 30 minutes, holding at 10:00
results.rules: When today opens above (below) the high (low) of yesterday's last 30 minutes and no bar in the first 30 minutes trades back into it, and at the 10:00 close price is above (below) VWAP, lean with the open. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Open inside yesterday's range, lean to the nearer extreme
results.rules: When the session opens inside yesterday's high-low and, at the 10:00 close, has touched neither extreme, lean toward whichever of yesterday's high or low is nearer (at least 0.5 ATR away). Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Developing day-range midpoint hold
results.rules: When the day's range is at least 2 ATR wide and the high came after the low, a bar that wicks down to the range midpoint (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back above it on an up bar leans long; the mirror image leans short. One signal per side per session, 10:30 to 14:30.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Raschke's 80-20 reversal (prior day opened in one 20% zone, closed in the other)
results.rules: Yesterday opened in the top 20% of its range and closed in the bottom 20% (range at least its recent average). Today price trades below yesterday's low, then a 5-minute bar closes back above it: lean long. Mirror for an up-and-reverse day: short. One signal per session, before 14:30 ET.

results.name: Rotation factor IB break
results.rules: Score each of the first hour's 5-minute bars +1 for a higher high, -1 for a lower high, and the same for the low (Dalton's rotation factor). If the total is +6 or more (or -6 or less), the first close beyond the initial-balance high (low) after 10:30 and before 15:00 leans long (short) with that one-sided rotation.

results.name: Same half-hour continuation, 10:00 window
results.rules: If yesterday's 10:00-10:30 move was at least one 5-minute ATR up (down), lean long (short) at the 10:00 open today. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Same half-hour continuation, 15:30 window
results.rules: If yesterday's 15:30-16:00 move was at least one 5-minute ATR up (down), lean long (short) at the 15:30 open today. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Thin-volume opening gap reverts
results.rules: The day opens at least 0.25% from yesterday's close, but the first 5-minute bar trades under 0.8x its usual volume and does not push on in the gap's direction (no more than 0.2 ATR). Nobody confirmed the gap, so the move leans back toward yesterday's close from the 9:35 bar, once per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Trend-day vote, first VWAP pullback
results.rules: At 10:30, a day earns a vote each for: 9 of 12 closes on one side of VWAP; the 10:30 close beyond the 15-minute opening range; the open within 25% of the IB range of the opposite extreme; first-hour relative volume at least 1.2; the 10:30 close in the outer 25% of the IB range. With 4 or more votes, the first bar to 13:30 that comes within 0.25 ATR of VWAP and closes on the trend side leans with the day. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Unfilled gap, then IB break with the gap
results.rules: The session opens above yesterday's high (below yesterday's low) and the whole first hour stays beyond it, so the gap is untouched. The first 5-minute close beyond the initial-balance high (low) in the gap direction, 10:30 to 14:30, leans with the gap. One signal per session.

results.name: Wide initial balance breakout
results.rules: When the 9:30-10:30 range is at least half the average daily range of the last 10 sessions, the first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance high or low between 10:30 and 14:00 leans with the break. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Wide first hour: pullback to its midpoint
results.rules: The first hour's range is at least 1.5x yesterday's and the 11:00 close sits in its top (or bottom) 25%: lean with the drive on the first bar before 14:00 that trades to the first-hour midpoint and closes back on the drive's side, once per session.

results.name: Williams volatility breakout
results.rules: A 5-minute bar that closes more than half of yesterday's high-low range above today's open while making a new session high leans long; the mirror below the open and a new low leans short. Between 9:45 and 14:30, one signal per session.

results.name: Breaker block first retest
results.rules: A big displacement bar (body 1.2 ATR or more, closing in its extreme quarter) leaves an order block, the last opposite-colour bar before it. If a later bar closes through the far side of that block within 15 bars, the block has failed and flips (a failed bullish block becomes resistance, a failed bearish block support). The first bar within 15 more bars that trades back into the block's body, does not close through its far side, and closes in the flipped direction is the signal. Before 15:00 ET, up to 3 per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Equal highs / lows liquidity sweep
results.rules: Two swing highs at least 3 bars apart and within 0.15 ATR of each other are equal highs, where stops cluster. A later 5-minute bar that trades above them but closes back below leans short; equal lows swept and reclaimed lean long. One signal per side per session, 10:30 to 14:30 ET.

results.name: Fair value gap first retest
results.rules: A 3-bar imbalance (bar 3's low above bar 1's high, or the mirror) at least 0.3 ATR wide. The first bar within 12 bars that trades back into the gap without closing through it and closes in the displacement direction (green for a bullish gap, red for bearish) leans with the displacement; a bar that trades through the gap voids it. Before 15:00.

results.name: Fair value gap first retest
results.rules: 3-bar imbalance (bar1 high < bar3 low, or bar1 low > bar3 high) leaves an unfilled gap; the first bar that trades back into it and closes back through the near edge confirms the gap held as support/resistance, before 15:00. A close through the far edge fills and cancels it.

results.name: Intrabar gap holding into the close
results.rules: Between 10:00 and 15:00 ET, a 5-minute bar that opens at least 0.4 ATR above the prior bar's close, closes at or above its own open and never trades back to the prior close leans long (mirror for a gap down). Up to two signals a day. Tested with and against.

results.name: Judas swing: false open move, close back through the open
results.rules: In the first hour, price pushes at least 0.5 ATR to one side of the day's opening price and never the other way, then a 5-minute bar closes back through the open. A false move down that closes back above the open leans long; a false move up that closes back below leans short.

results.name: Order block first retest
results.rules: A displacement bar (body at least 1.2 ATR, closing in the outer quarter of its range) marks the last opposite-colour bar before it (within 5 bars) as the order block. The first bar within 15 bars that trades back into the block's body, does not close through it, and closes in the displacement direction leans with the displacement; a close through the block voids it. Before 15:00.

results.name: Order block first retest
results.rules: A displacement bar (range >= 1.5x ATR, closing in the outer third of its range) marks the last opposite-colored candle before it as an order block. The first bar that trades back into that candle's range and closes back out the displacement side confirms the block held, before 15:00. A close through the block against the displacement cancels it.

results.name: Prior-week high/low sweep, close back inside
results.rules: A 5-minute bar before 14:30 that trades above the previous week's high but closes back below it leans short; one that trades below the previous week's low and closes back above it leans long. Needs 3+ sessions in the previous week. One signal per session.

results.name: SMT divergence at a session extreme
results.rules: Between 10:30 and 15:00, SPY or QQQ (or IWM or DIA) prints a new session high (or low) that is at least 6 bars past the previous one while its partner index fails to make a new high (or low) on the same bar. The signal is on the symbol that made the new extreme, in the direction it broke; tested with and against (fade). One signal per session per symbol.

results.name: SPY-led initial balance break
results.rules: Between 10:30 and 13:40, a stock closes beyond its first-hour range (initial balance) after SPY has already closed beyond its own first-hour range in the same direction, and SPY is still beyond it. The stock's first IB break of the session is the only candidate (if SPY hasn't led, no signal); tested with and against. SPY itself is skipped.

results.name: Beta-adjusted residual vs SPY, z-score stretch
results.rules: Take the stock's move from the open minus its beta (last 20 sessions, 5-minute returns) times SPY's move from the open. Divide by the standard deviation of that residual over the same 20 sessions. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when the z-score reaches +/-2.5 at a bar close, the signal points the way of the stretch; once per side per session. SPY is skipped. The lab tests it with the stretch and against it (mean reversion of the spread).

results.name: Stale day-extreme retake after 14:00
results.rules: From 14:00 to 15:30 ET, the first 5-minute close beyond the day's high (or low) so far, where that extreme was set before 12:00 ET, leans with the break. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Turtle Soup: false break of the prior 20-bar extreme
results.rules: A 5-minute bar that breaks below the lowest low of the prior 20 bars (that low at least 4 bars old) but closes back above it leans long; a break above the highest high of the prior 20 bars that closes back below leans short. One signal per side per session, 11:10 to 14:30.

results.name: Camarilla H3/L3 reversal
results.rules: Yesterday's Camarilla H3 = close + 1.1 x range / 4 (L3 the mirror). A 5-minute bar that trades through H3 but closes back below it, without reaching H4, leans short; through L3 and back above, without reaching L4, leans long. Before 15:00.

results.name: Camarilla H4/L4 breakout
results.rules: Yesterday's Camarilla H4 = close + 1.1 x range / 2 (L4 the mirror). A 5-minute close beyond H4 leans long, below L4 leans short, before 14:30.

results.name: Retest of the day's open after a move away
results.rules: Once price has closed at least 0.75 ATR above (below) the day's opening price, the first 5-minute bar between 10:00 and 14:30 that touches the open (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back on the same side leans with that side. Abandoned if price closes through the open instead. One signal per session.

results.name: Narrow CPR breakout
results.rules: When yesterday's central pivot range (BC to TC) is under 15% of yesterday's range, the first 5-minute close through the top (long) or bottom (short) of that range, 09:45-14:30, on at-least-normal relative volume leans in the break's direction.

results.name: Acceptance beyond yesterday's high/low
results.rules: Six 5-minute bars in a row that close beyond yesterday's high (low) without any bar trading back through it, before 14:30, leans in that direction: the market is accepting the new price area.

results.name: Break and retest of yesterday's high/low
results.rules: A 5-minute close beyond yesterday's high (low), then within 12 bars a pullback that trades within 0.1 ATR of that level and closes back on the breakout side, before 14:30, leans in the breakout direction.

results.name: Classic pivot R1/S1 bounce
results.rules: Classic floor pivot P = (H+L+C)/3 from yesterday's session; R1 = 2P-L, S1 = 2P-H. A probe of R1 that closes back below it leans down toward the pivot; a probe of S1 that closes back above it leans up toward the pivot. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Rejection at yesterday's closing VWAP
results.rules: A bar that wicks to within 0.1 ATR of yesterday's final session VWAP and closes back on the side it came from, as a down bar from below or an up bar from above, leans away from the level. One signal per session, 10:00 to 14:30.

results.name: Whole-dollar round-number rejection
results.rules: The whole-dollar level nearest a bar's open. A bar that opens below it, wicks through it, and closes back below leans down; a bar that opens above it, wicks through it, and closes back above leans up. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Wide CPR: R1/S1 touch rejected
results.rules: When yesterday's central pivot range (BC to TC) is at least 20% of yesterday's range, the first 5-minute bar from 10:00 to 14:00 that trades to the classic R1 (S1) and closes back below (above) it leans against the touch.

results.name: ALMA (9, 0.85, 6) cross with VWAP
results.rules: Arnaud Legoux Moving Average (window 9, offset 0.85, sigma 6): a 5-minute close crossing above it with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below it with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Aroon(25) crossover
results.rules: On 5-minute bars, Aroon Up (how recently the highest high of the last 25 bars printed) crossing above Aroon Down (how recently the lowest low printed) is a long signal; the reverse is a short. Only counted from about 11:40 (25 bars into the session) to 15:00, once per session.

results.name: Chandelier Exit flip
results.rules: The Chandelier Exit trails 3 average true ranges below the highest close of the last 22 bars (or above the lowest close). When the close breaks through the trailing line the trend flips. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first flip up leans long and the first flip down leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Choppiness Index trend start (CI14 < 38.2) with SMA20 side
results.rules: Between 10:00 and 14:30, the first bar where the 14-bar Choppiness Index drops below 38.2 (from at or above it) with the close above (below) the 20-bar SMA leans long (short). One signal per side per session.

results.name: Daily-trend-aligned VWAP pullback
results.rules: When the prior daily closes trend one way (last close beyond its 5-day average, itself beyond the average of the 5 days before), wait for price to stretch at least 0.5 ATR from VWAP on that side, then lean with the trend on the first bar that wicks to VWAP and closes back on the trend side in the trend direction. One signal per session, 10:00 to 14:30.

results.name: Ehlers Decycler Oscillator zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Ehlers' Decycler Oscillator (30-bar decycler minus 37.5-bar decycler, as percent of price, restarted each session): crossing above zero with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below zero with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: One-hour channel break with VWAP
results.rules: A 5-minute bar closing above the highest high (below the lowest low) of the previous 12 bars and on the same side of VWAP leans with the break; first break per side per session, 10:30 to 15:00.

results.name: Donchian 20-bar breakout with Hurst > 0.5
results.rules: A 5-minute bar closing above the highest high (below the lowest low) of the previous 20 bars, only when the Hurst exponent of the last 100 five-minute returns (aggregated-variance estimate, prior session included) is above 0.5, i.e. returns have been trending rather than mean-reverting. 11:05 to 14:55 ET, one signal per direction per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Intraday Donchian 10-bar channel breakout
results.rules: A 5-minute bar closing above the highest high of the previous 10 bars (50 minutes) leans long; closing below the lowest low of the previous 10 bars leans short. From 10:20 to 14:55, at most one signal per direction per session. Period fixed from published intraday defaults before testing.

results.name: Detrended Price Oscillator (20) zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Causal DPO(20): the close ten bars ago minus today's 20-bar average close. When it crosses zero and the bar closes on the same side of session VWAP, lean that way, 10:00 to 15:00 ET, at most two a session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers band-pass (20, 0.3) cross of its RMS line
results.rules: Ehlers band-pass filter (period 20, bandwidth 0.3) of the 5-minute closes, built from the session's first bar. When it crosses above its trailing RMS line (30 values) the setup leans long; when it crosses below the negative RMS line it leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Center of Gravity trigger cross at envelope edge
results.rules: Ehlers' Center of Gravity is a 10-bar weighted balance point of the bar midpoints; its trigger is the same line one bar later. Between 10:00 and 14:30 the first turn up through the trigger while the line is in the lowest fifth of its 20-bar range leans long, the first turn down in the highest fifth leans short. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Cyber Cycle trigger cross
results.rules: Ehlers' Cyber Cycle is a smoothed, detrended price wave (alpha 0.07); its trigger is the same wave one bar later. Between 10:00 and 14:30 the first upturn through the trigger while the wave is below zero leans long, the first downturn while above zero leans short. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Instantaneous Trendline trigger cross
results.rules: Ehlers' Instantaneous Trendline is a very low-lag smoothing of the bar midpoint (alpha 0.07), with a trigger line that leads it. Between 10:30 and 14:30, when the trigger crosses up through the trendline it leans long; crossing down leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Elder Impulse turn with VWAP side
results.rules: Elder Impulse System on 5-minute bars: a bar is green when the 13-bar EMA and the MACD (12,26,9) histogram both rose from the prior bar, red when both fell. The first green bar after a non-green one that closes above session VWAP leans long; the first red bar after a non-red one that closes below VWAP leans short. 10:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session.

results.name: Elder Ray pullback with EMA13 trend
results.rules: Elder Ray on 5-minute bars (EMA13 of closes, restarted each session). Between 10:00 and 14:30, if the EMA has risen over the last 6 bars, Bear Power (low minus EMA) is negative but higher than the bar before and the bar closes up: long. Mirror: EMA falling, Bull Power (high minus EMA) positive but lower than the bar before and the bar closes down: short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Elder Triple Screen (daily trend, Force Index dip, bar break)
results.rules: When the 5-day EMA of prior daily closes slopes up (down), wait for the 2-bar Force Index to be negative (positive) on the prior bar, then lean with the daily trend on the first bar that closes above the prior bar's high (below its low). One signal per session, 10:00 to 14:30.

results.name: EMA 9/21 crossover (golden/death cross)
results.rules: EMA9 crossing above EMA21 (golden cross) leans long; EMA9 crossing below EMA21 (death cross) leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00, after a 21-bar warmup.

results.name: EMA 9/20 pullback in trend
results.rules: EMA9 on one side of EMA20 with EMA20 sloping the same way over the last 5 bars marks a trending session. A bar that touches EMA9 against the trend and the next bar closes back beyond EMA9 in the trend's direction (and beyond the prior close) confirms the pullback held, before 15:00.

results.name: EMA 9/20 pullback in a trending session
results.rules: EMA 9 above EMA 20 above VWAP with EMA 20 rising over six bars (reverse for shorts). A bar that dips into the EMA 20 but closes back above it as an up candle (mirror for shorts) is the signal, 10:15 to 14:30 ET, one per side per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Even Better Sinewave (40/10) cross of -0.9 / +0.9
results.rules: Ehlers' Even Better Sinewave (high-pass 40, Super Smoother 10, 3-bar wave normalised by its power) crosses up through -0.9 (cycle start, leans long) or down through +0.9 (cycle end, leans short) on 5-minute closes between 10:00 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: FRAMA (16) close-cross with VWAP agreement
results.rules: Ehlers' fractal adaptive moving average over 16 five-minute bars speeds up in clean trends and slows in chop. Between 10:00 and 14:30 the first close crossing above it while above VWAP leans long, the first close crossing below it while below VWAP leans short. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Gann HiLo Activator flip with VWAP
results.rules: The HiLo Activator averages the highs and the lows of the last three bars. A 5-minute close above the high average turns the state up, a close below the low average turns it down. Between 10:30 and 14:30, the first flip from down to up that closes above VWAP leans long; the mirror flip below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Heikin Ashi trend candle on the VWAP side
results.rules: Two Heikin Ashi 5-minute candles in a row of the same colour, the latest with no wick on the trend side (green with a flat bottom, red with a flat top), and price closing on the same side of VWAP: leans with the trend. From 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session.

results.name: Holy Grail: first pullback to the 20 EMA in a strong ADX trend
results.rules: After ADX(14) on 5-minute bars is above 30 and rising (the push) with +DI over -DI (or under) and price on the trend side of EMA20, the first bar that tags EMA20 while ADX is still above 30 and still closes on the trend side of it leans with the trend. Only the first touch counts; one signal per side per session, before 14:30.

results.name: Hull MA(21) turn with VWAP agreement
results.rules: Hull moving average (21) of 5-minute closes turns up (slope flips from falling to rising) on a bar closing above session VWAP: lean long; turns down on a bar closing below VWAP: lean short. Starts after the first 21 bars have formed, until 14:30, at most 2 signals per session. Parameters fixed from the published Hull definition before testing. Tested with and against.

results.name: Ichimoku TK cross with VWAP agreement
results.rules: Tenkan (9-bar midpoint) crosses above Kijun (26-bar midpoint) on 5-minute bars and the bar closes above session VWAP: lean long; crosses below and closes under VWAP: lean short. Cloud omitted (needs more history than one session). Up to 2 a session, before 15:00.

results.name: Inventory retracement bar in a 20/40 EMA trend
results.rules: Price above EMA20 above EMA40 with EMA20 rising (mirror for down) is the trend. A bar with a wick against the trend of at least 45% of its range that closes in the trend's half is the inventory retracement bar; the first close beyond its high (low) within the next 3 bars is the signal, before 15:00.

results.name: KAMA(10,2,30) cross in an efficient market with VWAP agreement
results.rules: A 5-minute bar closes across Kaufman's adaptive moving average (10,2,30) while the efficiency ratio over the last 10 closes is at least 0.35 and the close is on the same side of session VWAP: lean long on an up-cross above VWAP, short on a down-cross below it. From 10:15 to 14:30, one signal each way per session. Parameters are Kaufman's published defaults, fixed before testing. Tested with and against.

results.name: Ichimoku Kijun pullback bounce with VWAP
results.rules: In an uptrend (Tenkan above Kijun, Kijun higher than 6 bars ago) a 5-minute bar dips to within 0.1 ATR of the 26-bar Kijun midpoint, closes back above it on an up bar and above VWAP: leans long (mirror for short). From bar 33 to 15:00 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Regression channel edge rejection
results.rules: Fit a straight line through the last 24 five-minute closes and draw bands 2 standard deviations of the residuals above and below. A bar that pokes above the upper band but closes back inside it leans short; one that pokes below the lower band and closes back inside leans long. 10:30-14:30, one per side per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.

results.name: Ehlers MAMA/FAMA cross with VWAP
results.rules: Ehlers' MESA Adaptive Moving Average (limits 0.5 / 0.05) crossing above its follower FAMA with the 5-minute close above VWAP leans long; crossing below with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: McGinley Dynamic (10) cross with VWAP
results.rules: McGinley Dynamic line (10, seeded at the session's first close): a 5-minute close crossing above it with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below it with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Morning efficiency-ratio trend continuation
results.rules: Efficiency ratio of the 5-minute closes from the open to 11:30 ET (net change divided by the sum of bar-to-bar moves). If it is 0.30 or more, the first bar before 14:30 that breaks and closes beyond the morning's high (up morning) or low (down morning) leans with the morning. One signal per session.

results.name: Parabolic SAR flip (5-minute)
results.rules: Wilder's Parabolic SAR (start 0.02, step 0.02, max 0.20) runs on the session's 5-minute bars. When price trades through the SAR the trend flips and that bar's close leans the new way: long when it flips up, short when it flips down. From 10:00 to 14:55, at most one signal per direction per session. Parameters are Wilder's defaults, fixed before testing.

results.name: Raff regression channel band touch in a high-R2 trend
results.rules: Least-squares line through the last 24 five-minute closes with R-squared of at least 0.80 and a fitted move of at least 1.5 ATR. Bands are 1.5 residual standard deviations from the line. In an up-trend a bar that reaches the lower band and closes back above it leans long; in a down-trend a bar that reaches the upper band and closes back below leans short. 10:30 to 14:55 ET, one signal per side per 12 bars; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Reflex (20) re-entry from +/-2
results.rules: Ehlers' Reflex oscillator (20-bar SuperSmoother compared with a straight line over the lookback, normalised by its RMS, restarted each session): a close where Reflex comes back above -2 leans long; coming back below +2 leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Flat regression channel band fade
results.rules: Fit a straight line through the last 30 closes and draw bands 2 standard errors either side. When the channel is flat (drift across the window under 2 standard errors) and, between 10:30 and 14:30, price closes back inside after the prior close was outside a band, it leans back toward the middle: long from below, short from above. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Roofing Filter zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Ehlers' Roofing Filter (48-bar high-pass into a 10-bar SuperSmoother, restarted each session): the filter crossing above zero with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below zero with the close below VWAP leans short. 11:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: SSL Channel (10) flip with VWAP
results.rules: Average of the last 10 highs and of the last 10 lows. A close above the high-average turns the channel bullish, a close below the low-average turns it bearish. A flip with the close on the same side of VWAP leans that way, 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Super Smoother (10) turn on the VWAP side
results.rules: Ehlers' 2-pole Super Smoother (period 10) of 5-minute closes turns up while the bar closes above VWAP (mirror: turns down below VWAP), between 10:00 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Supertrend flip with VWAP agreement
results.rules: Supertrend (10-bar ATR, multiplier 3) on 5-minute bars flips up and the flip bar closes above session VWAP: lean long; flips down and closes below VWAP: lean short. Parameters were fixed from published intraday defaults before testing, up to 3 flips a session, before 15:00.

results.name: Tillson T3 (14, 0.7) cross with VWAP
results.rules: Tillson T3 line (length 14, volume factor 0.7, seeded at the session's first close): a 5-minute close crossing above it after at least five closes below, with the close above VWAP, leans long; the mirror leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: TD Sequential countdown 13 (qualified)
results.rules: After nine 5-minute closes each below (above) the close four bars earlier, count bars that close at or below the low (at or above the high) two bars earlier, not necessarily in a row. Bar 13 must also trade to or beyond the close of count bar 8. Leans long (short) at that close before 15:00 as an exhaustion signal; a completed opposite 9 cancels the count. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: TD Sequential setup 9 (perfected)
