results.rules: Nine consecutive 5-minute closes each below (above) the close four bars earlier inside one session, with bar 8 or 9 making a lower low (higher high) than bars 6 and 7, leans long (short) at bar 9's close before 15:00 as an exhaustion signal.

results.name: Trend Intensity Index 80/20 cross with VWAP
results.rules: Trend Intensity Index (Pee): the share of the last 15 closes' distance from the 30-bar average that lies above it, scaled 0-100 (half of Pee's 60/30 so it fits one session). Between 11:00 and 14:30, when it crosses up through 80 with the close above VWAP it leans long; crossing down through 20 with the close below VWAP leans short. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ehlers Trendflex (20) zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Ehlers' Trendflex (20-bar deviation of a 10-bar SuperSmoother from its recent values, normalised by its RMS, restarted each session): crossing above zero with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below zero with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: TRIX signal-line cross against zero
results.rules: TRIX is the one-bar change of a triple-smoothed average of price (length 9), compared with its own 9-bar average. Between 10:30 and 14:30, the first time TRIX is below zero and crosses up through its average leans long (a pullback ending); the first time it is above zero and crosses down leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Vertical Horizontal Filter trend start with VWAP
results.rules: VHF compares the 28-bar high-to-low close range with the total distance price travelled; above 0.30 the market is moving in one direction. Between 11:50 and 14:30, when VHF crosses up through 0.30, price is above its close 28 bars ago and above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: VIDYA (9/12) break away from a flat line with VWAP
results.rules: Chande's VIDYA (CMO 9, EMA 12): when the line has gone flat (moved under 0.05 ATR over the last 3 bars), a 5-minute close crossing above it with the close above VWAP leans long; crossing below with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Vortex (14) cross with VWAP
results.rules: Vortex Indicator on 14 five-minute bars: VI+ crossing above VI- with the close above VWAP leans long; VI- crossing above VI+ with the close below VWAP leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, at most two signals per side per session.

results.name: Tight box breakout with VWAP
results.rules: Between 10:30 and 14:30, when the last eight 5-minute bars fit inside a box no taller than 3 ATR, the first bar that closes beyond the box on the same side of VWAP leans with the break. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: VWAP cross with ADX and a 6-bar range break
results.rules: Between 10:30 and 14:30 ET, a 5-minute bar that closes across session VWAP (the bar before was on the other side), with ADX(14) at or above 20 and rising, and that closes beyond the highest high (long) or lowest low (short) of the prior 6 bars. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Wilder Accumulation Swing Index leads price
results.rules: Wilder's Accumulation Swing Index (cumulated from the open) closes above its prior 12-bar high (or below its low) while the bar is on the same side of VWAP and price itself has not yet closed beyond its own 12-bar high (low): the index leads price. 10:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two a session. Leans with the ASI break. Tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Wilder DMI cross gated by ADX >= 25 and rising, with VWAP
results.rules: Wilder's directional movement on 14 five-minute bars: between 11:45 and 14:30 ET, when +DI crosses above -DI while ADX is at least 25 and rising and price closes above VWAP, it leans long; the mirror (-DI over +DI, price under VWAP) leans short. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Williams fractal break with Alligator aligned
results.rules: Bill Williams 5-bar fractal highs/lows on 5-minute bars. A close above the latest confirmed fractal high with the Alligator (SMMA 13/8/5 of median price) fanned up and the close above VWAP leans long; the mirror below a fractal low leans short. 10:30 to 14:30 ET, each fractal used once, at most two signals per side per session.

results.name: Average daily range exhaustion
results.rules: When the day's range has reached the average of the last 10 days' ranges, a bar that makes a new day high but closes down in its lower half (or a new low closing up in its upper half) marks a possible exhaustion; tested against the extreme (fade) and with it. One per side per session, 10:30 to 15:00.

results.name: ADX-gated VWAP 2-sigma stretch fade
results.rules: Only when ADX(14) on the session's 5-minute bars is below 20 (no trend): the first 5-minute close beyond VWAP +2 SD leans short, below VWAP -2 SD leans long, back toward VWAP. From 10:30 to 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session.

results.name: Bollinger Band failed break
results.rules: When a 5-minute bar closes outside the 20-bar, 2-standard-deviation Bollinger Band and the next bar closes back inside it, the move leans back toward the middle band: short after an upper-band failure, long after a lower-band one. Between 10:30 and 15:00, at most twice a day.

results.name: Bollinger squeeze then expansion
results.rules: Bollinger(20,2) band width at its 20-bar low marks a squeeze; the first of the next 6 bars whose close breaks back outside that bar's own bands leans with the breakout, before 15:00.

results.name: Chaikin Volatility spike beyond 1 VWAP stdev
results.rules: Chaikin Volatility (10-bar EMA of the bar range, rate of change over 10 bars) crossing up through +40 on a bar that closes more than one VWAP standard deviation from VWAP in the direction of the bar. Chaikin's reading is a panic low or blow-off high, so the setup leans long after a down spike and short after an up spike, 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one per side per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Daily Bollinger band tag against the 200-day trend
results.rules: In an uptrend (close above the 200-day average) a daily close below the lower Bollinger band (20 days, 2 standard deviations) leans long for a snap back; in a downtrend a close above the upper band leans short. Tested with and against.

results.name: Elder SafeZone stop flip
results.rules: Elder's SafeZone puts a stop two average 'noise penetrations' beyond the prior bar's low (for longs) or high (for shorts) and only lets it ratchet with the trend. Between 10:00 and 14:30 the first 5-minute close through the ratcheted long stop leans short, the first close through the ratcheted short stop leans long; one signal per side per session, tested with and against.

results.name: Keltner Channel breakout
results.rules: Keltner Channel: EMA(20) midline, bands at +/- 2x ATR(14). The first close above the upper band (from inside the channel) leans long; the first close below the lower band leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00, after a 20-bar warmup.

results.name: Early low, late high (extreme timing) at noon
results.rules: At 12:00 ET, if the session low printed in the first 30 minutes and the session high printed at or after 11:00, price is above VWAP and within 0.5 ATR of the high, it leans long; the mirror (early high, late low, below VWAP, near the low) leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Mass Index reversal bulge
results.rules: Add up, over 25 bars, how wide the 5-minute range is relative to its own smoothed average (the Mass Index). When it climbs above 27 and then drops back under 26.5 (a 'reversal bulge'), the trend is tiring: lean long if the 9-bar average of closes is falling, short if it is rising. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Narrowest half-hour so far: break with VWAP
results.rules: Cut the day into 30-minute blocks. When a block (the 4th or later) has the smallest range of the day so far and under 80% of the earlier blocks' average, watch the next half hour: the first close above that block's high while above VWAP leans long, the first close below its low while under VWAP leans short. Nothing after 14:30 ET. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: NR4 yesterday, then initial balance break
results.rules: Yesterday's range was the narrowest of the last four sessions. The first 5-minute close from 10:30 to 12:55 beyond today's initial balance high (low) is the signal; one per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Range-expansion day, first VWAP pullback
results.rules: When the day's range has already reached 70% of the 10-day average daily range by 11:00 ET, the side of VWAP price is on sets the day's direction. The first bar that touches VWAP and closes back on the trend side signals with the trend (tested with and against). One signal per session, until 14:30 ET.

results.name: Relative Volatility Index 50 cross with VWAP
results.rules: The Relative Volatility Index measures whether the recent size of price swings (10-bar standard deviation of closes) is coming on up bars or down bars, smoothed over 14 bars and scaled 0-100. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross up through 50 while price is above VWAP leans long, the first cross down through 50 while price is below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: ATR-Renko reversal confirmed by a second brick
results.rules: Renko bricks of half the opening 5-minute ATR are built from 5-minute closes (a reversal needs two bricks). When a run that began with a reversal gets its second brick, and the close is on the same side of VWAP, between 10:00 and 15:00 ET, the setup leans with the new run; at most two a session. Tested with and against.

results.name: STARC band tag closing back inside
results.rules: Bands sit 2 ATR above and below the 6-bar average close. A 5-minute bar that pokes through the upper band but closes back inside leans short (the mirror at the lower band leans long), between 10:00 and 14:30, if the previous bar did not also tag that band. At most two signals per session; tested with and against.

results.name: TTM Squeeze fire
results.rules: Bollinger(20,2) bands sit entirely inside Keltner(20 EMA, 1.5 x ATR20) for at least 6 five-minute bars. On the first bar they leave the channel, lean the way the momentum reading points (close vs the midpoint of the 20-bar range and SMA20), before 15:00. Tested with and against.

results.name: Turn of the month (long)
results.rules: Buy the close of the second-to-last trading day of each month and hold per the lab's exit; no other condition.

results.name: Turnaround Tuesday (Monday down 1%+)
results.rules: When a Monday closes at least 1% below the previous trading day's close, lean long at the next open (Tuesday). One signal per qualifying Monday.

results.name: Mean-reverting tape (variance ratio < 0.8): VWAP 1.5-sigma stretch snaps back
results.rules: Between 12:00 and 14:30, when the variance ratio of the last 30 five-minute returns at a 4-bar horizon is below 0.8 (price has been mean-reverting rather than trending), a bar that closed beyond VWAP +/- 1.5 standard deviations and is followed by a bar closing back inside the band leans back toward VWAP (stretched high: short). One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Wide-range bar follow-through
results.rules: Between 10:00 and 14:30, the first 5-minute bar whose high-to-low range is at least 2x the usual 5-minute ATR and that closes in the top (or bottom) fifth of its range leans with that direction. One per day.

results.name: Williams MFI green bar breaking the 6-bar range
results.rules: A 5-minute bar where volume and range-per-volume (Williams' Market Facilitation Index) both rise versus the previous bar, body at least 60% of range, relative volume at least 1.2, closing beyond the prior six bars' high (or low), 10:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two a session. Leans with the bar. Tested with and against.

results.name: Williams VIX Fix capitulation spike
results.rules: Measure how far the 5-minute low has fallen below the highest close of the last 22 bars (Larry Williams' VIX Fix). When that drop jumps above its own Bollinger band (20 bars, 2 sd) or above 85% of its 50-bar high, the selling looks like a capitulation low: lean long; the mirror (high far above the lowest close of 22 bars) leans short. One signal per side per session, only after about 13:00 ET when enough bars exist; tested with and against.

results.name: A/D line breaks its 20-bar range before price does
results.rules: The running Accumulation/Distribution line closes above its prior 20-bar maximum (or below its minimum) while the bar closes on the same side of session VWAP and price has not yet broken its own prior 20-bar high (or low). 10:15 to 14:30 ET, at most two a session. Leans with the money flow. Tested with and against.

results.name: Afternoon first VWAP touch on a one-sided day
results.rules: If at least 80% of the 5-minute closes before 13:00 sit on one side of VWAP, the first bar between 13:00 and 15:30 that touches VWAP and still closes on the trend side leans with the day. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Amihud price-impact spike bar
results.rules: A bar between 10:00 and 15:00 ET whose body moved at least 3x as far per share traded as the average of the previous 20 bars, and whose body is at least 0.8 ATR. Signal on its close in the body's direction; one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Anchored VWAP retest from the day extreme
results.rules: From 10:30 to 14:30, VWAP anchored at the session's low (or high) so far, at least 8 bars old. After 3 bars closing on the anchor's side of it, a bar that wicks to the anchored VWAP and closes back on that side in that direction leans away from the anchor. One signal per side per session.

results.name: Two-day balance area breakout
results.rules: If yesterday's and the day before's 70% value areas overlap by at least 70% of the narrower one, the first 5-minute close after the initial balance (first hour) and before 14:00 beyond the outer edge of the two value areas leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Chaikin Oscillator zero cross + VWAP
results.rules: The Chaikin Oscillator (3-bar EMA minus 10-bar EMA of the session's accumulation/distribution line) crossing above zero while price closes above VWAP leans long; crossing below zero while price closes below VWAP leans short. After the first 12 bars, before 15:00 ET, at most two a session; tested with and against.

results.name: Cumulative buying/selling pressure divergence
results.rules: Add up each 5-minute bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (top = all buying, bottom = all selling). A new session high (low) at least 8 bars after the last one, with that running total below (above) where it stood at the earlier extreme, and a bar closing against the extreme, leans against the extreme (fade) or with it, both tested. One per side per session, 10:30 to 14:30.

results.name: Chaikin Money Flow zero cross + VWAP
results.rules: Chaikin Money Flow over the last 20 five-minute bars of the session crosses from at or below zero to +0.05 or more while price closes above VWAP leans long; from at or above zero to -0.05 or less while price closes below VWAP leans short, before 15:00. Tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Initial-balance break with cumulative-volume surge
results.rules: The first close beyond the initial-balance high (long) or low (short) between 10:30 and 13:00 ET, counted only if the session's cumulative volume so far is at least 1.5x the average cumulative volume at the same bar over the previous 10 sessions. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Developing POC first retest after a 1.5 ATR excursion
results.rules: Build the day's volume profile as it stands bar by bar. After price has closed at least 1.5 ATR away from the developing point of control, the first return to it (within 0.05 ATR) that closes back on the side price came from, in that direction, is the signal. 10:30 to 14:30, one a session.

results.name: Developing value-area re-entry
results.rules: After 11:00, when a close beyond the session's developing value-area high (low) by 0.1 ATR is followed by a close back inside it, lean toward the developing POC (short from above, long from below), before 14:30.

results.name: Double-distribution neck
results.rules: From 12:00 to 14:00, if the session's volume profile shows two separate fat regions at least 1.5 ATR apart (each at least 60% of the heaviest price) joined by a thin neck (under 35% of the smaller region), the first close at least 0.25 ATR above (below) the neck marks which distribution price has settled in. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Ease of Movement (14) zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Arms' Ease of Movement (midpoint change per unit of relative volume, 14-bar average, restarted each session) crosses zero between 10:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: VWAP 2-sigma stretch in a choppy tape (efficiency-ratio gated)
results.rules: Between 11:00 and 14:30 ET, when Kaufman's Efficiency Ratio over the last 20 closes (net move divided by the sum of bar-to-bar moves) is below 0.25, a bar that closes 2 or more VWAP standard deviations below VWAP signals a long back toward VWAP, and 2 or more above signals a short. One signal per side per session. Tested with and against; the stretch is only read when the tape has been going nowhere.

results.name: Retest of yesterday's excess high/low
results.rules: Yesterday's profile (5 bps bins): if the session high (low) has a tail, meaning at least two consecutive bins from the extreme down (up) that only one 5-minute bar touched, it is an excess extreme. Today, the first bar before 14:00 that trades within 0.05 ATR of that extreme or beyond it but closes back on the inside leans away from it (short at an excess high, long at an excess low). Cancelled for that side if a bar closes beyond the extreme first. Tested with and against; up to one signal per side per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: First low-volume pullback to VWAP
results.rules: After at least six 5-minute closes on one side of VWAP, the first bar to touch VWAP (or close within 0.1% of it) on lighter average volume than the run, closing back on the trend side in a trend-direction candle, leans with the run. 10:00 to 14:30, one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Force Index (13) zero cross with VWAP
results.rules: Elder's Force Index (close change times volume, 13-bar EMA, restarted each session) crosses through zero between 10:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Heavy-volume first hour, direction held at 10:30
results.rules: When the first hour (9:30-10:30) trades at 1.5x or more of its usual volume, and price at 10:30 is at least 0.5 ATR beyond the open and on the same side of VWAP, lean with that direction. One trade per session.

results.name: High-volume bar midpoint retest
results.rules: After 10:00, a bar with at least 3x the session's average bar volume, a range of at least 1 ATR and a close in its top (bottom) 30% marks a level. The first later bar before 14:30 that trades back to the bar's midpoint (within 0.1 ATR) and closes on the bar's side leans long (short). Abandoned if price closes beyond the far end of the bar. One signal per session.

results.name: IB break confirmed by cumulative close-location delta
results.rules: Between 10:35 and 14:30, the first bar that closes beyond the initial-balance high (low) while the session's cumulative volume-weighted close-location delta and the last 6 bars' delta are both positive (negative) leans long (short) with the break. One signal per side per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Initial balance inside yesterday's value, first break
results.rules: When the first hour's high and low both sit inside yesterday's 70% value area, the first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance (before 14:00) leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: IB breakout on heavy first-hour volume share
results.rules: If the first hour's volume was at least 25% of yesterday's full-day volume, the first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance (first hour) before 14:00 leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Initial balance break with VWAP on the break side of the IB midpoint
results.rules: The first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance (before 14:00) counts only if session VWAP is above the IB midpoint for an upside break, or below it for a downside break. One signal per session; a first break against the VWAP lean is skipped. Tested with and against.

results.name: Bollinger tag confirmed by normalized Intraday Intensity
results.rules: Intraday Intensity weighs each 5-minute bar's volume by where it closed in its range and sums the last 21 bars. Between 10:30 and 15:00, if price closes at or below the lower Bollinger band while that buying/selling pressure reading is still positive, it leans long (a reversion); at or above the upper band with a negative reading it leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Initial-volume-bar anchored VWAP retest
results.rules: VWAP anchored at the heaviest 5-minute bar of the first 30 minutes. From 10:00 to 14:30, after 3 closes at least 0.1 ATR on one side of it, a bar that wicks to it (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back on that side leans away from it; one per side per session.

results.name: Initial volume bar failed breakout
results.rules: After the first 30 minutes, the heaviest 5-minute bar defines the initial volume bar. A close beyond its high or low that is taken back inside its range within 3 bars is a failed break; the close back inside leans against the break, 10:00 to 14:00. One signal per session.

results.name: Kalman-filtered price crossing VWAP
results.rules: A local-level Kalman filter (noise ratio 0.15, restarted each session) of the 5-minute typical price crosses session VWAP from below (above) and the bar closes on the same side of the Kalman line, between 10:00 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Klinger oscillator signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: The Klinger Volume Oscillator (standard 34/55/13, restarted each session) crosses its signal line between 11:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Anchored VWAP from the day extreme, first retest
results.rules: Anchor a VWAP at the day's running low (high). Once price has closed at least 1.5 ATR away from it, the first bar between 10:00 and 15:00 ET that dips to the anchored VWAP and closes back on the trend side (up bar for a long, down bar for a short) is the signal. One per side per day. Tested with and against.

results.name: Quiet lunch drift away from VWAP reverts
results.rules: If the 11:30-13:30 lunch hours trade at under 80% of their usual volume and price at 13:30 sits at least 1 ATR away from VWAP, the drift lacks participation, so lean back toward VWAP. One trade per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Money Flow Index leaving an extreme, stretched from VWAP
results.rules: The 14-bar Money Flow Index (typical price x volume, up-bars versus down-bars) climbs back above 20 while price closes at least 1 volume-weighted standard deviation below VWAP (leans long), or falls back below 80 while price closes at least 1 above VWAP (leans short), between 10:45 and 14:30. One per side per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.

results.name: Morning move on fading volume reverses
results.rules: By 10:30 price is at least 0.5 ATR from the open, but the 10:00-10:30 half hour traded under 60% of the 9:30-10:00 volume: the push is losing participation, so the move leans back against the morning direction. One trade per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Naked POC first touch
results.rules: A prior session's point of control that no later session has traded through is a naked POC. When today's price first reaches the most recent one (at least one ATR from the open) between 10:00 and 15:00, the setup leans in the direction of travel into it; tested with and against (fade). One signal per session.

results.name: Narrow prior value area, IB breakout
results.rules: If yesterday's 70% value area (VAH-VAL) was no wider than 0.30% of yesterday's close, the first 5-minute close beyond today's initial balance (first hour) before 14:00 leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Negative Volume Index EMA cross with VWAP
results.rules: A Negative Volume Index built from the session's 5-minute bars (it moves with price only on bars whose volume is lower than the bar before) crosses above or below its 20-bar average between 11:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: OBV divergence at a new session extreme
results.rules: A new session low whose on-balance volume (restarted each session) is higher than at the previous session low, 6+ bars earlier, and that closes as an up bar leans long; a new session high with lower OBV than at the previous high that closes as a down bar leans short. 10:30-14:30 ET, one signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: One-timeframing loss of control
results.rules: After six straight bars that each make a higher high and higher low (or lower high and lower low), the first bar closing through the prior bar's far end shows the controlling side has stopped; lean against the old run. After 10:00, before 15:00, at most two per session.

results.name: Open outside prior value: first pullback to VAH/VAL
results.rules: The session opens above yesterday's value area high (or below the value area low). The first bar before 14:00 that wicks back to that level and closes beyond it again leans with the opening direction; cancelled if a bar closes back through the level first. Once per session, tested with and against.

results.name: Opening-range POC retest after a breakout
results.rules: Take the volume profile of the first 30 minutes and its point of control. After price closes beyond the 30-minute high (low), a later bar before 14:00 ET that dips (pokes) back to the opening-range POC and closes back above (below) it on a candle in the breakout direction signals a long (short). One signal per side per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Opening range break with VWAP slope
results.rules: First 5-minute close beyond the 15-minute opening range, before 11:00, counts only if session VWAP has moved the same way by at least 0.05 ATR over the last 3 bars and the close is on that side of VWAP; one signal per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.

results.name: Pocket pivot
results.rules: A daily close above the prior close, on volume greater than every down day's volume in the prior 10 sessions, with the close above its 10-day average, is a pocket pivot (institutional buying outweighing recent selling). The mirror image (down day, volume above every prior-10 up day, close below the 10-day average) is the bearish version.

results.name: Power-hour range breakout
results.rules: Mark the 14:00-15:00 ET range. If it is at most a third of the day's range so far, the first 5-minute close beyond it between 15:00 and 15:40 on at least 1.2x normal volume leans with the break. Tested with and against.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Prior-close cross on a volume spike
results.rules: The first hour (initial balance) trades entirely below (or above) yesterday's close. The first 5-minute bar before 14:00 ET that closes through yesterday's close on 1.5x normal volume leans with the cross: long through it from below, short through it from above.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: Yesterday's volume climax at its extreme, first hour agrees
results.rules: When yesterday's volume was at least 1.5x the average of the ten sessions before it and it closed in the top (bottom) fifth of its range, and at the 10:30 close price is above (below) VWAP, mark that direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Yesterday's secondary high volume node first-touch rejection
results.rules: Yesterday's profile (5 bps bins): a second peak at least 6 bins from the POC, with at least 70% of the POC's bin volume and the highest volume within 2 bins either side, is the secondary HVN. Today, price trades on one side; the first bar before 14:00 that wicks to the HVN but closes back on the approach side leans in the approach direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session, cancelled if a bar closes through the HVN first.

results.name: Yesterday's low volume node first-touch rejection
results.rules: Yesterday's profile (5 bps bins): the lowest-volume bin inside the value area, at least 3 bins from the POC and at most 60% of the value area's mean bin volume, is the LVN. Today, price trades on one side; the first bar before 14:00 that wicks to the LVN but closes back on the approach side leans in the approach direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session, cancelled if a bar closes through the LVN first.

results.name: Yesterday's peak-volume bar: first-touch hold
results.rules: Take yesterday's single highest-volume 5-minute bar. Between 09:45 and 13:55 ET, the first time price comes down from above and dips to the bar's high but closes back above it, it leans long; the first time it comes up from below to the bar's low and closes back under, it leans short. Skipped when the bar is narrower than 0.3 ATR. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Yesterday's POC first-touch rejection
results.rules: Price trades on one side of yesterday's POC; the first bar that wicks to the POC but closes back on the approach side, before 14:00, leans in the direction of the approach. Tested with and against; one signal per session, cancelled if a bar closes through the POC first.

results.name: Break of yesterday's VWAP +/-1 stdev band on volume
results.rules: Yesterday's session VWAP plus and minus one volume-weighted standard deviation is treated as value. The first bar between 10:00 and 14:30 that closes outside the band (previous bar inside) on at least 1.2x its usual volume for that time of day leans in the break direction. Once per session, tested with and against.

results.name: Profile shape (p / b) at 11:00
results.rules: At the first 5-minute close at or after 11:00 ET, build the volume profile of the session so far. If its POC sits in the top third of the day's range so far (p-shape) the setup leans long; in the bottom third (b-shape) it leans short. Skipped when the range so far is under 1.5 ATR. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Positive + Negative Volume Index agreement with VWAP
results.rules: Two volume-split price indexes are built from the session's 5-minute bars: PVI moves with price only on bars with more volume than the bar before (the crowd), NVI only on bars with less (the quiet money). When both move above their own 20-bar averages between 11:00 and 14:30 while price closes above VWAP, it leans long; both below with price under VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Percentage Volume Oscillator signal cross with VWAP
results.rules: The Percentage Volume Oscillator compares a fast (12-bar) and slow (26-bar) average of 5-minute volume; when it crosses above its 9-bar signal line, volume momentum is picking up. Between 10:30 and 14:30, if that bar also closes up and above VWAP it leans long; closing down and below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Price Volume Trend divergence at a new session extreme
results.rules: The session's Price Volume Trend (running sum of volume times each 5-minute bar's % price change) fails to confirm a new session closing high (it sits below its value at the previous high, which was at least 6 bars earlier) leans short; a new closing low on a PVT above its value at the previous low leans long. After 18 bars, before 14:30 ET, one signal a session; tested with and against.

results.name: Anchored VWAP from the session extreme, first reclaim
results.rules: Anchor a VWAP at the session's low (high), at least 8 bars old and still the extreme. When a bar closes up (down) through that anchored VWAP after the previous close was on the other side, that bar is the signal, between 10:00 and 14:30. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.

results.name: Fill through yesterday's single-print zone
results.rules: Yesterday's widest price bin touched by only one 5-minute bar (a thin, fast passage) is the single-print zone. The first bar today that trades into it and closes back out the side it entered from leans WITH that close (continuation through the thin spot), before 15:00.

results.name: Break of yesterday's poor high/low
results.rules: If yesterday's session high (low) bin was touched by more than one 5-minute bar, the auction didn't reject it cleanly (a poor high/low, unfinished business). The first close today beyond that poor high (low) leans WITH the break, before 15:00. A clean (single-touch) high/low is left untested by this setup.

results.name: Thin-volume first-hour extreme
results.rules: At 10:30 the close is in the top (bottom) 10% of the first-hour range, the range is at least one ATR, and first-hour volume is under 80% of yesterday's first hour. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Twiggs Money Flow +/-0.05 cross + VWAP
results.rules: Twiggs Money Flow (smoothed ratio of gap-aware accumulation/distribution volume to volume, 12-bar span) crossing above +0.05 while price closes above VWAP leans long; crossing below -0.05 while price closes below VWAP leans short. After the first 12 bars, before 15:00 ET, at most two a session; tested with and against.

results.name: Two-day composite POC first-touch rejection
results.rules: Build the volume profile of the last two sessions together and take its POC; skip the day when it sits within half an ATR of yesterday's own POC. Between 09:45 and 13:55 ET, when price approaches it from one side, the first bar that wicks to the level and closes back on the approach side leans in the direction of the approach. Cancelled if a bar closes through it first. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Yesterday's value area edge: first retest after opening outside
results.rules: The session opens above yesterday's VAH (below yesterday's VAL). The first bar from the 4th bar to 14:00 whose low (high) comes within 0.1 ATR of that edge while it closes still outside value leans long (short): old value edge flips to support (resistance). Cancelled if any bar closes back inside value first. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: Value migrating: two-day step in POC, VAH and VAL
results.rules: Yesterday's POC, value area high and value area low are all higher (or all lower) than the session before's. At the 10:30 close, if price is on that side of yesterday's POC and of today's VWAP, lean with the migration. Once per session, tested with and against.

results.name: Volume-confirmed 20-day breakout
results.rules: A daily close above the prior 20-day high (below the 20-day low) on volume at least 1.5x the prior 50-day average, closing in the upper (lower) half of the day's range, leans with the break into the next session. Tested with and against.

results.name: Volume divergence at a new session high/low
results.rules: A bar that makes a new session high (low) at least six bars after the previous extreme, on less than 60% of that earlier extreme bar's volume, and closes in the lower (upper) half of its range, between 10:30 and 14:30, leans against the push. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.

results.name: Volume-ramp exhaustion beyond VWAP
results.rules: Three bars in a row close in the same direction (each above its open and above the prior close) with volume rising on every bar, the third closing in the top (bottom) quarter of its range and more than 1.5 ATR beyond session VWAP, between 10:00 and 14:30 ET. One signal per side per session; signal is in the direction of the push, tested with and against.

results.name: Volume thrust bar closing at its extreme
results.rules: A bar with at least 2.5x its usual volume for that time slot and a range of at least 1.5 ATR that breaks the session high (low) and closes in the top (bottom) 20% of its range leans with the thrust, between 10:00 and 14:30. One per side per session.

results.name: Volume Price Confirmation Indicator (5/20) turns positive
results.rules: VPCI = (20-bar VWMA minus SMA) x (5-bar VWMA / SMA) x (5-bar volume / 20-bar volume), per session. When it crosses above zero, lean toward the side of the 20-bar average the close is on, if session VWAP agrees, 10:00 to 15:00 ET, at most two a session. Tested with and against.

results.name: VWAP 1 SD band first pullback holds
results.rules: After two consecutive 5-minute closes beyond the +1 SD VWAP band (or below -1 SD) within the last hour, the first bar that touches the band and closes back on the trend side leans with the trend, 10:00-14:30, once per side per session.

results.name: VWAP 2-sigma stretch on fading volume
results.rules: A 5-minute bar whose high pierces VWAP +2 sigma (low pierces -2 sigma), closes against the stretch, on less volume than the average of the previous three bars, leans back toward VWAP. Up to two signals a session, 10:00 to 15:00.

results.name: VWAP 1 SD band walk (four closes outside)
results.rules: Four 5-minute closes in a row beyond the +1 SD VWAP band (or below -1 SD), with VWAP sloping the same way over the last half hour, lean with the walk at the fourth close, 10:00-14:30, once per side per session.

results.note: fewer than 30 in-sample signals for every variant
results.name: VWAP tag-and-hold in a trending session
results.rules: After six bars closing on one side of VWAP with VWAP drifting at least 0.5 ATR that way, a bar that wicks to VWAP and closes back on the trend side in the trend direction leans with the trend. One signal per side per session, 10:00 to 14:30.

results.name: VWAP break then first retest
results.rules: A 5-minute bar closing 0.4 ATR beyond VWAP right after a close on the other side is a break. The first bar 2 to 8 bars later that touches VWAP (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back on the break side leans in the break direction; one per side per session, 10:00 to 14:30.

results.name: VWAP chop, then compression break
results.rules: After at least four VWAP crosses since the open, when the last hour's range is no more than 60% of the initial balance, a 5-minute close beyond that hour's high (above VWAP) or low (below VWAP) between 11:30 and 14:30 leans with the break, once per session.

results.name: Chop day: failed poke of the IB extreme
results.rules: When price has crossed VWAP at least 4 times by 11:30 (a balanced, rotating day), the first bar between 11:35 and 14:30 that trades through the initial-balance high but closes back inside leans short; through the IB low but closes back inside leans long. One signal per session.

results.name: Failed VWAP reclaim (trapped breakout traders)
results.rules: After six or more closes on one side of VWAP, price closes on the other side for only one or two bars, then closes back on the original side between 10:00 and 14:30. Lean toward the original side; tested with and against. One signal per session.

results.name: Held one side of VWAP for the whole first hour
results.rules: If all twelve 5-minute closes of the first hour sit on the same side of VWAP, the open is on that side, and the 10:30 close is at least 0.25 ATR away from VWAP, lean the same way. Tested with and against; one signal per session.

results.name: First VWAP cross after a long one-sided stretch
results.rules: When price has closed on one side of VWAP for at least 30 straight 5-minute bars (2.5 hours), the first close on the other side of VWAP between 12:05 and 14:30 ET signals in the direction of the cross (a trend day losing its anchor). One signal per session.

results.name: Morning trend with no VWAP touch, read at noon
results.rules: From 10:30 to 11:55 no 5-minute bar touches VWAP (all lows above it, or all highs below it) and the 11:55 close is at least 6 five-minute ATRs from the day's open on that side. Signal at the 11:55 close, one per session; tested with and against.

results.name: VWAP + developing POC confluence rejection
results.rules: After 10:30, when VWAP and the session's developing point of control are within 0.3 ATR of each other, a pullback that wicks into that zone and closes back on the side price came from, in that direction, leans with the bounce (and its fade is tested). One signal per side per session, to 14:30.

results.name: VWAP retest beyond the prior day extreme
results.rules: Once price has traded above yesterday's high and VWAP is above it too (mirror for lows), a bar after 10:00 that wicks to VWAP and closes back above it on an up bar leans long (down bar below VWAP leans short). One signal per side per session, before 12:30.

results.name: VWAP second touch in a one-sided session
results.rules: When the session has stayed on one side of VWAP since the first half hour and price touches VWAP for the second time (at least 4 bars after the first), closing back on the trend side in the trend's direction, lean with the trend. 10:30 to 14:30, one signal a session.

results.name: VWAP side persistence into 11:00
results.rules: From 09:35 to the first bar at or after 11:00 ET, at least 90% of closes sit on one side of session VWAP and VWAP has moved the same way over the last 6 bars: lean with that side at the 11:00 close (long above, short below). One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Midday VWAP slope turn
results.rules: VWAP drifted one way from 10:30 to 11:30 (at least 0.5 ATR), then reversed from 11:30 to 13:00 (at least 0.25 ATR), and at 13:00 price is on the new side of VWAP. One signal per session, in the direction of the new VWAP slope; tested with and against.

results.name: VWAP tail rejection
results.rules: A 5-minute candle whose whole body sits above VWAP, closes up, and whose lower wick reaches VWAP (within 0.05 ATR) and is at least as long as the body and 0.3 ATR leans long; the mirror below VWAP leans short. Up to two signals a session, 9:45 to 14:30.

results.name: Volume Zone Oscillator re-entry from +/-40
results.rules: Each 5-minute bar's volume counts as buying on an up close and selling on a down close; the Volume Zone Oscillator is the 14-bar smoothed signed volume as a percent of smoothed volume. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross back up through -40 leans long and the first cross back down through +40 leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Weis wave: low-volume pullback after a high-volume thrust
results.rules: Swing waves from a 1-ATR zigzag. After a thrust of at least 2 ATR, a counter-wave that retraces at most 62% of it on at most 60% of its volume is complete once price turns back 1 ATR; that bar's close, on the thrust side of VWAP, signals continuation (long after an up-thrust, short after a down-thrust). 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Volume climax reversal at a session extreme
results.rules: A bar with at least 3x its usual volume for that time slot and a range of at least 2 ATR that makes a new session low (high) but closes in the top (bottom) 40% of its range is a selling (buying) climax: lean long (short) on the reversal, before 15:00. One per side per session.

results.name: Effort without result: absorption bar at a session extreme
results.rules: A 5-minute bar with at least 2x its usual volume but a range under 0.6 ATR, sitting at the session low, shows selling being absorbed; a close above that bar's high within 6 bars leans long. The same bar at the session high followed by a close below its low leans short. Before 15:00.

results.name: High-volume range-break trap
results.rules: Price closes outside the previous 12 bars' range on at least 1.5x normal volume (10:30-14:30 ET). If within the next 3 bars a bar closes back inside that range, the break is read as failed: lean against it at that close (a failed break up is a short, a failed break down is a long). One per side per session. Tested with and against.

results.name: VSA no-demand / no-supply bar, confirmed
results.rules: A narrow-spread bar on lower volume than the two bars before it, with a wick rejecting the move (up bar with an upper wick = no demand; down bar with a lower wick = no supply). When the next bar closes the other way beyond the signal bar's close, that is the signal: short after no demand, long after no supply. Between 10:45 and 15:00 ET, one per side per session; tested with and against.

results.name: Wyckoff spring / upthrust at the IB extreme
results.rules: After the initial balance, a bar wicks beyond the IB low (high) and closes back inside on below-average volume for that time slot (low effort) while closing in the outer half of its own range against the wick (strong result): the effort-vs-result divergence marks a spring (lean long) or upthrust (lean short), before 15:00. One per side per session.

results.name: Williams squat bar after an extended leg
results.rules: After a 6-bar leg of at least 1.5 ATR, a 5-minute bar with more volume than the one before it but less range per unit of volume (a Williams squat bar) and at least 1.5x its usual volume shows the leg meeting opposition. A close within 3 bars back through the squat bar's far side leans against the leg. Before 15:00.

results.name: Volume dry-up pullback above/below VWAP
results.rules: After six closes on one side of VWAP, a three-bar pullback against that side on steadily shrinking volume that never touches VWAP, then a bar that closes beyond the pullback's extreme in the trend direction, between 10:00 and 14:30. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.
